staff_quote: 比之前的感觉是更专业了，之前直接转发老板微信，我觉得这个录单可以用。但是有重复录单的风险，同时年月日自己填写应该去做一个下拉。目前看是没有解析错的，产品这一块系统卡的很严格，我觉得很好。
staff_quote_en: It feels more professional than before — before, I just forwarded orders to the boss on WeChat. I think this order entry is usable. So far nothing was parsed wrong; the system is very strict about products, which I think is good.
